recent_calls.summary: The user, Ed, rescheduled an interview for a plumber technician position to Friday at 12 PM and provided the interview location and topics to discuss. The agent successfully booked the appointment and confirmed the details with Ed. The user expressed satisfaction with the call and gave a feedback rating of four.
The user requested to speak with someone, and the agent promptly transferred the call to a live agent. The transfer was completed successfully without any issues.

The agent confirmed the details, collected the homeowner's phone number, and assured Jeff that the team would follow up and schedule the appointment. The call ended with both parties satisfied and no further requests.
